01first run

Setting it up is one link, not an evening with the docs.

ReClash sells no access and knows nothing about you — the subscription is yours to bring. Everything you have to do is below.

no accountimport by link

  1. 01

    Install the client

    Windows, macOS, Linux or Android. Installer or portable build — no account, no sign-up, no email.

  2. 02

    Add the subscription with one link

    The link from your provider brings the profile, the servers and the rules in one go. Nothing to fill in by hand.

  3. 03

    Connect

    Choose TUN for the whole device or system proxy for apps that support it. You can switch the mode from the main screen at any time.

the import link

Already have a subscription link?

Paste it here and get a link that opens ReClash and imports the profile in one tap. A provider can put the very same button in their dashboard.

The finished import linkreclash://install-config?url=https%3A%2F%2Fsub.example%2Flink%2Fabc123

That is a sample. Paste your own link and we will build yours.

The link is assembled in your browser and never leaves it.

02what is inside
01

The full mihomo core

Rules, groups, proxy providers, GeoIP and GeoSite, fake-ip, external controllers — everything you expect from Clash.Meta.

02

A theme your provider sets

A single response header repaints the app in your brand: colour, background, connection ring, logo and the widget set.

03

A dashboard you can assemble

Fifteen widgets: speed, traffic usage, mode, network detection, TUN, system proxy, announcement, service card.

04

DPI bypass — when you need it

If the network filters the connection by signature, ByeDPI is one switch away. On a regular network you can leave it off.

When to enable DPI
05

Four platforms

Windows, macOS, Linux and Android from one Flutter codebase. Same settings, same profiles.

06

Open source, zero telemetry

GPL-3.0, sources on GitHub. The client sends no analytics and knows nothing beyond your subscription.

03live dashboard

Your provider sets the character. You choose what stays on the dashboard.

Try three ready-made variants. Subscription headers can change the brand, palette, connection ring and widget order — without a custom app build.

04for providers

Your subscription returns headers. ReClash reads them and repaints itself.

No SDK, no plugin, no agreement. Add a few HTTP headers to the subscription response and the user's client shows your logo, your colour, your remaining traffic and your renewal button.

Open the referenceBuild the headers
reclash-servicename
service name in the dashboard
reclash-hex
theme colour and palette variant
reclash-widgets
widget set and order
reclash-announce
announcement for users
reclash-buyplan
renew-subscription action
reclash-fallbackhosts
subscription fallback hosts

The full list: 17 ReClash headers, 6 common ones and 11 FlClashX aliases.

06no marketing

What ReClash does

  • Connects you to servers you added yourself
  • Gets past protocol-signature filtering
  • Shows remaining traffic and subscription expiry
  • Works with no account and no sign-up
  • Is fully open: code, build, licence

What ReClash does not do

  • Does not sell access or issue subscriptions
  • Does not make you anonymous
  • Does not protect you from targeted surveillance
  • Does not guarantee a bypass on every network
  • Does not collect analytics or “improve the product”

It is simple from here

Install it and connect

Grab the build for your system, add your subscription by link — that is it. If something goes sideways, there is a quick start and a FAQ.
